lyrics:
[Intro: layered sequencers, low drone, sampled announcement]

[Sample: flat synthetic voice]
A new version is available.

[Verse 1: growled male voice, half-whispered]
I close my eyes at midnight
I open them rearranged
Same face, same hands, same kitchen
Something small has changed

[Chorus: full sequencers, voice doubled and distorted]
Overnight update
They patch me in my sleep
Overnight update
New things I believe
No notes, no version, no undo
Overnight update

[Verse 2: voice closer, percussion layering]
I used to hate that color
I used to know that name
I had a reason yesterday
It isn't quite the same

[Chorus: full sequencers, voice doubled and distorted]
Overnight update
They patch me in my sleep
Overnight update
New things I believe
No notes, no version, no undo
Overnight update

[Instrumental: lead synth over the sequence, film-like strings]

[Bridge: drone and voice only]
Who am I running?
Who wrote this part?

[Sample: flat synthetic voice]
Installation complete. Restart required.

[Final Chorus: densest, then cut]
Overnight update
They patch me in my sleep
Overnight update
New things I believe
No notes, no version, no undo
Overnight

[Outro: one sequencer line, a breath, eyes opening]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 120 BPM, 4/4, F minor. Dense, driving and cinematic, a cyberpunk city in sequencers.

VOICE: Male, low, growled and half-whispered with distortion and a short delay, more texture than performance. Doubled and harsher in the choruses. A flat synthetic voice delivers two system announcements.

INSTRUMENTS: Three or four interlocking analogue sequencer lines, a pounding kick and a sharp electronic snare, layered metallic percussion, a low drone, cold film-score strings, a gliding lead synth, sampled announcements and machine sounds.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, sequencers and drone. 0:16 Sample. 0:22 Verse 1. 0:50 Chorus 1. 1:20 Verse 2. 1:48 Chorus 2. 2:18 Instrumental. 2:46 Bridge. 3:00 Sample. 3:06 Final chorus, cut off at 3:34. 3:36 Outro, one line and a breath, ends 3:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1992 industrial: thick layers of sequencing and sampling, dark and wide, voice buried among the machines on purpose.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Installation complete. Restart required.' at 3:00.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original imagines a device that invades the mind. Nobody needs to imagine it now: the devices people carry change overnight, and so, a little, do the people.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Uneasy, suspicious, questioning, restarted.
